whyItMatters: Override-based build launches are one of the most direct ways to weaponize CodeBuild. They can change commands, secret handling, and runtime behavior without altering the underlying project definition.

threatContext.attackerBehavior: An attacker may inject a malicious buildspec or override runtime variables to exfiltrate secrets, run arbitrary commands, or pivot into broader cloud access.
threatContext.realWorldUsage: This is attractive because the override happens at execution time and can avoid more durable configuration changes.
threatContext.whyItMatters: The presence of an override materially changes the risk of a build launch and deserves separate detection from the generic baseline.
threatContext.riskAndImpact: If missed, defenders may overlook the exact moment a trusted CI/CD path was converted into arbitrary execution or secret exposure.

requiredLogSources: AWS CloudTrail management events for CodeBuild
loggingRequirements: CloudTrail must preserve the override fields in StartBuild requests.
The environment should classify which projects or actors may legitimately use overrides.
Follow-on build-role activity should be available for correlation.
limitations: Some teams legitimately use overrides for testing or dynamic build control.
CloudTrail may not fully capture the runtime impact of all override values.
The override event alone does not confirm successful malicious execution.

enrichment.description: Determine whether the actor and project are allowed to use build overrides.
enrichment.falsePositiveReduction: Separates expected engineering workflows from risky execution changes.

enrichment.description: Classify what the project can access during runtime.
enrichment.falsePositiveReduction: Raises urgency when overrides land on highly privileged projects.

enrichment.description: Inspect the override for outbound calls, secret handling, or arbitrary execution patterns.
enrichment.falsePositiveReduction: Improves triage of genuinely dangerous overrides.

logicExplanation.humanReadable: This rule should detect `StartBuild` requests that include execution-changing overrides. It should treat `buildspecOverride` and `environmentVariablesOverride` as high-risk launch modifiers and then use project and actor context to determine urgency.
logicExplanation.tuningGuidance: 1. Keep the override presence checks exact. 2. Classify which projects and actors may legitimately use overrides. 3. Escalate strongly when the override lands on a sensitive project or the content is clearly execution-changing.
logicExplanation.whenToFire: Fire whenever StartBuild includes buildspec or environment-variable overrides.

quality.falsePositiveRate: Low-Medium with project and actor context

deployment.scheduling: Real-time is strongly preferred because override-backed builds can execute immediately.
considerations: This is the dangerous-modifier branch of the CodeBuild family.
Override authorization and content-risk analysis are the main enrichments.
